description_en: Sends a request to the WhatsApp Conversions API
name: RequestWhatsappConversionApi

parameters.help_en: The space ID or instance ID of the customer
parameters.name: cust_space_id

fields.help_en:
Specifies where the conversion occurred. Knowing where the event occurred helps ensure that ads are delivered to the correct audience. By using the Conversions API, you agree that the action_source parameter is accurate to the best of your knowledge.


The values you can send in the action_source field are as follows:


email: The conversion occurred through email.
website: The conversion was made on a website.
app: The conversion was made on a shift application.
phone_call: The conversion was made over the phone.
chat: The conversion was made through a messaging app, SMS, or online messaging feature.
physical_store: The conversion was made in person at a physical store entity.
system_generated: The conversion occurred automatically, such as a subscribe renewal with Settings for monthly automatic payment.
other: The conversion was made through a method not listed in this topic.

Note: All action source values support ads measurement and custom audience creation. All action sources except physical_store support ads optimization
fields.help_zh:
您可通过此字段指定转化发生的位置。了解事件发生的位置有助于确保将广告投放至正确的受众。使用转化 API，即表示您同意：就您所知 action_source 参数准确无误。


您可在 action_source 字段中发送的值如下：


email — 转化通过邮件发生。
website — 转化在网站上完成。
app — 转化在移动应用上完成。
phone_call — 转化通过电话完成。
chat — 转化通过消息应用、短信或在线消息功能完成。
physical_store — 转化在实体店面对面完成。
system_generated — 转化自动发生，例如将订阅续费设置为每月自动支付。
other — 转化通过本文未列出的其他方式完成。

注意：所有操作来源值都支持广告成效衡量和自定义受众创建功能。所有操作来源（除 physical_store 外）都支持广告优化功能
fields.name: action_source

fields.help_en:
Required parameters for app events.

These parameters are used to share app data and device information with the Conversions API
fields.help_zh:
应用事件必要参数

这些参数用于将应用数据和设备信息分享给转化 API
fields.name: app_data

fields.help_en: A map that contains additional business data for the event
fields.help_zh: 包含事件其他企业数据的映射
fields.name: custom_data

fields.help_en: The processing options you want to enable for a specific event. For Limited Data Use, the currently accepted value is LDU. You can send an empty array to explicitly specify that the event must not be processed with Limited Data Use restrictions
fields.help_zh: 您希望为特定事件启用的处理选项。对于受限数据使用，当前可接受值为 LDU。您可以发送一个空数组来明确指定，不得使用“受限数据使用”限制来处理此事件
fields.name: data_processing_options

fields.help_en:
Required if you send LDU under data_processing_options.
The country you want to associate with this data processing option. Currently accepted values are 1 (representing the United States) or 0 (requesting that we geolocate this event)
fields.help_zh:
如果您在 data_processing_options 下发送 LDU，则为必要项。
您希望与此数据处理选项相关联的国家/地区。当前可接受值为 1（代表美国），或者 0（请求我们为此事件进行地理定位）
fields.name: data_processing_options_country

fields.help_en:
Required in some cases. (See the notes below for details.)
The state you want to associate with this data processing option. Currently accepted values are 1000 (representing California) or 0 (requesting that we geolocate this event)
fields.help_zh:
在某些情况下为必要项。（查看下方备注以了解详情。）
您希望与此数据处理选项相关联的州/省。当前可接受值为 1000（代表加利福尼亚州），或者 0（请求我们为此事件进行地理定位）
fields.name: data_processing_options_state

fields.help_en: This ID can be any unique string chosen by the advertiser. The event_name and event_id parameters are used to deduplicate events sent by a website (through Meta Pixel), an app (through the SDK or App Events API), and the Conversions API. Although event_id is marked as optional, we recommend that you use this parameter for deduplication
fields.help_zh: 此编号可以是广告主选定的任何唯一字符串。参数 event_name 和 event_id 用于删除由网站（通过 Meta Pixel 像素代码）或应用（通过 SDK 或应用事件 API）以及转化 API 发送的重复事件。请注意，虽然我们将 event_id 标记为可选项，但是建议您在删除重复事件时采用此参数
fields.name: event_id

fields.help_en:
The name of a standard event or custom event. This field is used to deduplicate events sent by a website (through Meta Pixel), an app (through the SDK or App Events API), and the Conversions API. The event_id parameter is also used for deduplication.

For the same customer action, the event from the browser or app should match the event_name from the server event. If a match is found between events sent within 48 hours, only the first event is considered. If server and browser/app events are received at approximately the same time (within 5 minutes of each other), the browser/app event takes priority. Learn more about deduplicating Pixel events and server events
fields.help_zh:
标准事件或自定义事件的名称。此字段用于删除由网站（通过Meta Pixel 像素代码）或应用（通过 SDK 或应用事件 API）以及转化 API 发送的重复事件。event_id 参数也用于删除重复事件。

对于相同的客户操作，浏览器事件或应用事件的 event 应与服务器事件的 event_name 相符。如果我们在 48 小时内发送的事件之间找到匹配项，则只考虑第一个事件。如果几乎同一时间收到服务器和浏览器/应用事件（即彼此相差 5 分钟以内），则将优先考虑浏览器/应用事件。详细了解删除重复的 Pixel 像素代码事件和服务器事件
fields.name: event_name

fields.help_en: The browser URL where the event occurred. The URL must start with http:// or https:// and should match the verified domain
fields.help_zh: 事件发生的浏览器网址。此网址必须以 http:// 或 https:// 开头，并且应与已认证的网域相匹配
fields.name: event_source_url

fields.help_en: A Unix timestamp in seconds indicating when the event actually occurred. The specified time may be earlier than the time you send the event to Facebook. This is intended for batch processing and server performance optimization. You must send the date in Greenwich Mean Time (GMT) time zone format
fields.help_zh: Unix 时间戳（以秒为单位），表示事件的实际发生时间。指定时间可能早于您将事件发送至 Facebook 的时间。其目的在于实现批处理和服务器性能优化。您必须以格林威治标准时间 (GMT) 时区格式发送该日期
fields.name: event_time

fields.help_en:
Required parameters for app events.

Extended device information, such as the width and height of the screen. This parameter is an array with values separated by commas. When using extinfo, all values are required and must be arranged in the following index order. If a value is missing, use an empty string as a placeholder
fields.help_zh:
应用事件必要参数

扩展设备信息，例如屏幕的宽度和高度。此参数是一个数组，各个值之间使用逗号分隔。使用 extinfo 时，所有值均为必要项，并且必须按照以下索引顺序排列。如果缺少某个值，则需使用空字符串作为占位符填充
fields.name: ext_info

fields.help_en: A flag that indicates this event should not be used for ad delivery optimization. When set to true, the event can only be used for attribution
fields.help_zh: 表示不应将此事件用于广告投放优化的标记。设置为 true 时，该事件仅可用作归因条件
fields.name: opt_out

fields.help_en: A map that contains customer information data
fields.help_zh: 包含客户信息数据的映射
fields.name: user_data

The response code.

A value of OK indicates that the request was successful.

For other error codes, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196974.html）

返回OK代表请求成功。

其他错误码，请参见[错误码列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196974.html）
